summary: Iteration 160: Complete testing of Password Reset and Email Verification features (P1). All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend pages verified - Login with '¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?' link, Forgot Password form, Reset Password page (with/without token), Verify Email page (with/without token). All endpoints working correctly with proper error handling.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns generic message for both existing and non-existing emails (security measure)
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with invalid email format returns 422 validation error
POST /api/auth/reset-password with invalid token returns 400 with 'Token inválido o ya utilizado'
POST /api/auth/reset-password with short password (<8 chars) returns 422 validation error
POST /api/auth/verify-email with invalid token returns 400 with 'Token de verificación inválido o ya utilizado'
POST /api/auth/resend-verification with auth returns success message
Login with rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve / NuevaPass123! works correctly
Frontend forgot password form shows email input and 'Enviar Enlace de Recuperación' button
Frontend forgot password form shows 'Volver al inicio de sesión' back button
Frontend /reset-password without token shows 'Enlace Inválido' error with red X icon
Frontend /reset-password?token=xxx shows form with 'Nueva Contraseña' and 'Confirmar Contraseña' fields
Frontend reset password form validates password match and shows 'Las contraseñas no coinciden' error
Frontend reset password form shows 'Token inválido o ya utilizado' error for invalid tokens
Frontend /verify-email without token shows 'Error de Verificación' with 'Token de verificación no proporcionado'
Frontend /verify-email?token=xxx with invalid token shows 'Token de verificación inválido o ya utilizado'
seed_data_creation: Test users created during full reset flow test and cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password Reset and Email Verification features fully implemented. The forgot-password endpoint always returns the same generic message regardless of whether the email exists (security measure). The password_reset_tokens collection stores tokens with 'used' field. The reset invalidates all existing sessions for the user. Email sending may fail silently (SMTP not configured) but endpoints still return success. Frontend pages: /login (with forgot password link), /reset-password (with/without token), /verify-email (with/without token). All data-testid attributes are properly set for testing.
